reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new one, goes through the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget and averageBudgetAmount helpers, and the new action is registered like its siblings.

duplication.why: The rule is centralised, but the same categories+groups+notes SELECT is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg instead of one category-loading helper.

placement.why: Exclusion rules live in the shared predicate in budget/actions.ts; the new action and handler sit with the other month-wide actions.

scope.why: Stays on month-wide actions; some unformatted long signature/type lines are left behind.

maintainability.why: The single predicate with one includeHiddenCategories flag is easy to own, but the five copied queries must stay in sync when the predicate needs another column.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions call shouldWriteMonthBudget; the hidden filter was removed from the average queries so it is no longer decided in SQL.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category query is copied verbatim, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget in budget/actions.ts: the per-action 'zero' special case was removed and replaced by one includeHiddenCategories flag; template and #fixed conditions are added as general rule terms; every action calls it.
